description: Guilin University of Electronic Technology and Chinese Academy of Sciences partners downscale precipitation over Guangxi and ASEAN regions for 2001–2020. One-kilometre monthly fields combine GPM IMERG rainfall with MODIS vegetation, evapotranspiration and surface temperature plus ASTER elevation through geographically weighted regression. ScienceDB repository applies CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for free access; the inspected description does not name the raster container. The fields can drive regional water-balance and irrigation simulations. Validation uses 2,679 stations, but agreement at those sites does not remove uncertainty elsewhere. Monthly precipitation cannot directly resolve flood-producing storm hydrographs. The monthly products are derived from annual downscaling and proportional allocation. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Downscaled monthly precipitation dataset at 1 km resolution over Guangxi, China and ASEAN regions from 2001 to 2020
